fields.title: New column name
fields.description: Name of the new column in the output table

fields.title: Content column
fields.description: Data bound content of the XML element. A column with XML, numeric or string data can be chosen here. In the latter case XML special characters are automatically escaped in order to get valid XML
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Remove source columns
fields.description: Check when the source columns should not show up in the output table. Source columns are the content column and the columns used for the data bound name and the data bound attributes

fields.title: Element name type
fields.description: Name of the created XML element. A custom name will be equal for every row whereas data bound name takes its value from an input column

fields.title: Custom element name
fields.description: Custom name for the XML element

fields.title: Data bound element name column
fields.description: Column providing the element name for each row
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Data bound attributes
fields.description: Attributes added to the XML element with data bound values can be defined here

fields.title: Custom attributes
fields.description: Attributes added to the XML element can be defined here
